summary.text: Patty McMahon is the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado's 6th District. She describes a career of more than 30 years at the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and says she is running as an independent voice outside partisan politics.

paragraphs.text: McMahon earned a high school diploma from Bishop Gorman High School and a bachelor's degree from Metropolitan State University of Denver in 1989. Her Ballotpedia profile lists her career experience as a writer.

In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, she says she spent over three decades at the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, beginning as an investigator and later serving as Denver's Outreach & Education Coordinator and congressional liaison for 25 years. Her campaign website puts her time in federal service at 35 years.

She says she was selected as Region VIII Lead for the White House Initiative on Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders, and in 2004 was chosen for a committee that reorganized the EEOC.

McMahon says she serves on Colorado nonprofit and civic boards and has worked as a campaign director and public relations director for congressional candidates from different parties. She says she has lived in the district for 26 years.
